response.text:
**I accept the bounded CHR-03 earned Cleric2→3 Bishop module**, with frozen implementation `2733b9fd75e2159ad73312b9583311693b925598` and final evidence `72def9d77ae66bd81f811bbfc74c4cbbaf7b1d25`. I found no remaining acceptance blocker within the approved TEST_ONLY wire112/base90 scope.

My independent reconciliation confirmed:

- **Unchanged engine:** the final evidence commit has the same engine tree as the reviewed freeze. All **453 compilation-input hashes, 947 static-input hashes and 83 historical source blobs** reconcile.
- **Evidence integrity:** the final ZIP matches its declared size/SHA256, and all **6,321 members** match their indexed lengths and hashes.
- **Original regression:** all **1,570 unique cases pass**, preserving the 1,566 predecessors’ relative order and shard assignments. The six original starts, PIDs, assignments, ordered journals, completions and DONE markers reconcile. I also read the four DLLs’ MVIDs directly from their PE metadata and matched them to the worker records.
- **Fresh five paths:** every `paths-v2` file matches its reference across **105 canonical, 315 filtered-view and 2,790 behavior comparisons**, plus all 105 unchanged saves after probes. All **108 focused artifacts** match the completed original campaign; the **29 inherited canonical artifacts** remain identical.
- **Compatibility and restoration:** the retained 28 wire95–110 continuations, 112 older console views, 13 authentic wire111 checkpoints and 100 accepted/current comparisons reconcile. The wire112 rejection/recovery files preserve the specified live state, backup and displaced-primary bytes.

The harness correction supplies the existing public constructor defaults. Its failed attempt remains separate, and the complete fresh five-path result does not combine successful prefixes. Neither stopped regression contributes to acceptance. [Final reconciliation](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/72def9d77ae66bd81f811bbfc74c4cbbaf7b1d25/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-chr03-bishop-runtime/final/FINAL_RECONCILIATION.json)

The retained genuine results establish the approved connected effects: Invocation healing **7/6** and actual fear cure, Aura changing the natural9 save outcome, concentration contribution, positive Rite/Radiance/Aura healing, and individually observed own-Guidance Dispel followed by paid continuation. Supplemental three-target, altered-state and positive-vent controls retain their disclosed limits. Finite survival and later pressure remain explicit.

**Verification limits:** I performed source inspection and independent read-only Git, byte/hash, JSON, journal and binary-metadata checks. I did not compile C#, execute gameplay, restore saves, rerun the qualification drivers or observe workers. Those executions remain Codex’s retained evidence.

**The immediate next gate is a bounded CHR-05 Consecrate / Consecrated Ground SOURCE/API contract review.** Both cards are already owned, while their terrain effects remain explicitly unsupported. This advances the reusable simulation through persistent, source-owned zones connected to movement, attacks, healing and shared timing. The Bishop work already supplies the reviewed Invocation ownership/payment/vent path; that work should not be repeated. [Current capability boundary](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/2733b9fd75e2159ad73312b9583311693b925598/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConnectedExpeditionView.cs#L63)

Preserve **CHR-05 ← CHR-03, TAC-02, TAC-05, TAC-08**. The contract must resolve actual Action/RP payment; zone geometry, replacement, expiry and recharge; positive Consecrated Ground healing with explicit Radiance/Aura ordering and caps; persistence and authority; and lawful Undead classification plus an actual attack-penalty witness. Any missing actor/source/context must return as a concrete prerequisite—no new encounter or inherited evidence exception is automatically approved.

That authorizes **contract preparation and review only**, not successor runtime. Whole-engine completion, broader P1 responsiveness, unsupported capabilities and production promotion remain open. Unity remains deferred; storage cleanup and GitHub Support remain held.
